title: crypto identity proxy: terraform module to bridge HSM-backed KMS with Vault and Secrets Manager
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Create a production-ready Terraform module that provisions a lightweight "crypto identity proxy" inside customer VPCs to federate key operations between HSM-backed KMS (cloud HSM or on-prem PKCS#11 HSM) and secrets backends (HashiCorp Vault and AWS Secrets Manager). The module must support both online (cloud-HSM) and air-gapped (on-prem HSM + offline attestation) modes, expose stable outputs for IAM roles/service accounts and KMS aliases, and include a small Kubernetes controller (deployed as part of the module) that handles secret rotation, healthchecks, and forced failover to software-KMS variants during degraded hardware events.

Scope: module API, example usage, upgrade path, healthcheck CRDs (if k8s present), drift detection hooks, and a migration helper to import existing secrets into HSM-wrapped keys. This ticket covers the TF module code, unit/integration test harness, docs, and a canary rollout plan for early customer validation.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes inputs for: target_kms_provider (aws|gcp|azure|pkcs11), hsm_attestation_endpoint, vault_addr, vault_token_secret, iam_role_arns, kms_key_policy_overrides, and rotation_schedule
Module produces stable outputs: kms_key_arn, kms_key_alias, iam_role_for_proxy, service_account_name, proxy_healthcheck_endpoint
Kubernetes controller manifests are rendered by the module (optional) and when applied perform rotation of a test secret using HSM-wrapped key
Healthcheck API returns 200 when HSM is reachable and KV cache/rotation watcher is operational; alert rules in example Grafana are included
Upgrade path documented: new module versions can be applied with zero-secret-downtime via canary key alias and atomic alias swap
Integration tests running in CI validate: key creation, Vault transit integration, Secrets Manager replication (AWS), and simulated HSM outage failover to soft-kms
Security review checklist completed and HSM attestation flow documented for air-gapped deployments
implementation_notes: Technical approach: implement Terraform module that composes providers: aws, google, azurerm (where applicable), hashicorp/vault, and a small local exec-based helper to interact with PKCS11 HSM for on-prem flows. The module will create: (1) a KMS key or HSM alias with lifecycle policies; (2) an IAM role/service account with least-privilege grants and a KMS grant bound to the proxy; (3) a lightweight proxy Deployment (k8s) or ECS task that performs signing/decryption operations via HSM; (4) Vault transit mount + key (or configure AWS Secrets Manager replication) wired to use the new key. Important outputs and a 'kms_key_arn_override' input allow staged canary-based rollouts. Use remote-state importers and resource targeting in migration helper. Keep resources optional (k8s, aws) so module can be reused across private/on-prem/private-cloud combos.
migration_plan: 1) Add module to customer infra in a non-production namespace and create a canary key (kms_key_alias = <app>-canary). 2) Import one low-risk secret and confirm proxy rotation works. 3) Run a smoke consumer that validates signatures/decrypts using canary key. 4) When validated, create the production key, copy metadata via migration helper, switch alias to production atomically, monitor error rate and latency. 5) If HSM outage is simulated, proxy should switch to soft-kms fallback under operator control until recovery. 6) Run final reconciliation and mark old keys for scheduled retirement.
testing_plan: Unit tests for Terraform plan generation (tftest) and input validation
Integration test in CI using ephemeral AWS account: create key, write/read secret from Vault transit, rotate via controller, verify rotation timestamp in secret metadata
Air-gapped flow smoke: simulate PKCS11 HSM via softpkcs11 shim in CI to exercise attestation code paths
Chaos test: kill HSM process during rotation window and assert fallback to soft-kms and alert generation
Performance test: measure proxy latency under 1000 TPS to assert latency <= 15ms added for sign/decrypt ops (SLO)
